name: Noble County, Indiana (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of dark blue, yellow and orange, the yellow charged with a black circle containing a tipi and two tomahawks, the word NOBLE above and the date 1836 within.
history: Noble County is a county in Indiana. The flag was adopted on 1 June 1982 (adopted by order of the Board of County Commissioners on 1 June 1982 and codified in the county code effective 1 January 1985, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: black circle with a tipi, two tomahawks, NOBLE and 1836
